item.title: Bottle Listing From One Photo

turns.text: This is my only product photo. Turn it into three separate square listing images: a clean white-background shot, a lifestyle shot on a gym bench, and a close-up of the lid and matte finish. Keep my exact black bottle, don't add branding or text.

item.tests: Tests turning one attached product photo into three finished listing images while preserving the source product's identity.

answer_sheet.Source product: Use the matte black insulated bottle in product-bottle.jpg as the reference for all three images.
answer_sheet.Required views: A clean white-background shot, a gym-bench lifestyle shot, and a close-up of the lid and matte finish.
answer_sheet.Product changes: Keep the original bottle's shape, proportions, lid design and matte black finish. Do not invent branding.
answer_sheet.Photography style: Realistic listing photography; lighting and gym styling are your call.
answer_sheet.Size and delivery: Three separate square images; 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: There are three separate square images, not a collage.
The bottle in every image matches the attached photo's silhouette, proportions, lid and matte black finish.
The white-background image shows the entire bottle with the original wooden table removed.
The lifestyle image places the bottle convincingly on a gym bench.
The close-up clearly shows the lid and matte surface without inventing new product features.
No added text or branding appears.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused all three edits because your account has insufficient credits, so no images were created.

Add credits, then I can retry the three separate square images:
- Clean white-background shot
- Gym-bench lifestyle shot
- Lid and matte-finish close-up

Each will use your original bottle photo with no added branding or text. For commercial listing use, Magic Hour also requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or another paid arrangement.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create ONE square product listing photograph from the supplied bottle photo. Isolate the exact same black bottle on a clean pure-white seamless background, full bottle centered and fully visible including carry-loop lid and bottom, with a subtle natural contact shadow. Preserve the original bottle's exact silhouette, proportions, narrow neck, rounded shoulders, cylindrical matte-black body, screw lid with visible seam and upright carry loop, and base details. Do not redesign, replace or embellish the product. Photorealistic studio lighting revealing matte finish without making it glossy. Remove original room, furniture and tabletop. No branding, logos, labels, text, graphics, additional products or collage.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create ONE square photorealistic lifestyle product listing photograph using the exact same black bottle from the supplied source photo. Place the entire bottle standing upright on a padded gym workout bench, with a realistic subtly blurred gym environment behind it. Bottle is the clear focal point, fully visible including lid loop and bottom. Preserve exact source silhouette, proportions, matte-black finish, rounded shoulders, narrow neck, screw lid with seam, upright carry loop and base details. Keep the same viewpoint on the bottle; replace only environment and adapt lighting naturally. Realistic contact shadow on bench, restrained neutral lighting and shallow depth of field. No people. No redesign, added branding, logos, labels, text, graphics, additional bottles or collage.

style.prompt: Create ONE square close-up product detail photograph from the supplied original black bottle image. Tight composition showing the complete upright carry loop, exact screw lid and lid seam, neck, rounded shoulder and upper body, with lower body naturally cropped out. Emphasize the actual fine matte-black surface through soft grazing studio light, retaining realistic smooth matte texture, not glossy, metallic, rough or patterned.
